$description: Singularity design tokens, W3C DTCG format. Three tiers: primitive (raw scales), semantic (roles, light plus dark), component (sizes and bindings). Colors are OKLCH strings. Non-standard $type values (singularity-fluid-dimension, singularity-easing) are compiled by scripts/buildTokens.ts and ignored by other tools. Dark values live in $extensions.singularity.mode.dark; $extensions.singularity.reducedMotion replaces a value under prefers-reduced-motion; $extensions.singularity.concentric records an outer radius that must equal inner radius plus padding. Values for durations, easings and thresholds follow ~/.agents/DESIGN.md.

grey.$description: Neutral. The blue hue at a whisper of chroma, so greys sit with the accent. 50 and 900 are the light and dark pages; surfaces between them are the elevation group.

blue.$description: The one accent. Low steps are tints, middle steps fills and accent text, high steps ink; which step a role takes is in the semantic tokens.

orange.$description: Warning. Clear orange, not brown: hue 47 keeps step 500 at 4.5:1 as text.

elevation.$description: Surface tones between the neutral ramp's steps: the page step moved by a few points of lightness. Ten ramp steps are about 8 points apart; elevation reads at 2 to 5.

shadow.$description: Layered, hue-tinted shadows. Higher elevation is cooler and more diffuse. Light and dark are separate literals because dark surfaces express depth by lightness and a rim highlight, not by cast shadow alone.

raised-light.$description: One step of lift, no ring: a focused search field, a raised control.

1.$description: The one step under 8: an icon beside its own label, a title onto its subtitle in one row, a chip's or button's inner gap, a focus-ring or hit-area offset, an optical nudge. Never a gap between separate things.

space.$description: 4px base, 25 percent minimum step. Gaps within a group are at most half the gaps between groups.

read.$description: Same family as the interface. Kept as its own token so story text can change voice without touching components.

blackletter.$description: The Halloween style's page title face: blackletter, latin only, one 9 KB file. Only the display role takes it (D306); no component reads this token.

meta.$description: A line of facts. Level with label (14px): two sizes that close are one size that looks like a mistake.

reading.$description: Story and summary text: 16px everywhere, never smaller than the interface around it.

title.$description: A story's headline: 18px on a phone, 20px at 1280px, a clear step above the 16px text under it.

tracking.$description: Size-specific tracking: large text tightens, small text opens slightly.

drawer-full.$description: The single documented exception to the 300ms ceiling: a full-height drawer on the drawer curve. Spring tokens are measured by their own perceptualMs, not their settle time.

spring-settle.$description: Total time of the generated linear() curve. Perceptual duration is 350ms; the tail is sub-pixel.

spring-spatial-fast.$description: Total time of the generated linear() curve; perceptual time is where it stays within 5%.

spring-spatial-default.$description: Total time of the generated linear() curve; perceptual time is where it stays within 5%.

spring-spatial-slow.$description: Total time of the generated linear() curve; perceptual time is where it stays within 5%.

spring-effects-fast.$description: Total time of the generated linear() curve; perceptual time is where it stays within 5%.

spring-effects-default.$description: Total time of the generated linear() curve; perceptual time is where it stays within 5%.

spring-effects-slow.$description: Total time of the generated linear() curve; perceptual time is where it stays within 5%.

spring-spatial-fast.$description: Material 3 Expressive spatial fast spring, stiffness 800, damping 0.6; overshoots 9.5%.

spring-spatial-default.$description: Material 3 Expressive spatial default spring, stiffness 380, damping 0.8; overshoots 1.5%.

spring-spatial-slow.$description: Material 3 Expressive spatial slow spring, stiffness 200, damping 0.8; overshoots 1.5%.

spring-effects-fast.$description: Material 3 Expressive effects fast spring, stiffness 3800, damping 1, no overshoot.

spring-effects-default.$description: Material 3 Expressive effects default spring, stiffness 1600, damping 1, no overshoot.

spring-effects-slow.$description: Material 3 Expressive effects slow spring, stiffness 800, damping 1, no overshoot.

spring.$description: Parameters for gesture-driven springs in script. duration is perceptual; bounce 0 is critically damped. Apple damping ratio = 1 minus bounce.

state.$description: State layers, as Material draws them: a control keeps its own fill, and a hover or a press lays this share of its text colour over it. One pair of numbers for every control.

dim.$description: A thing that is busy or being moved stays where it is, quieter: a page that is loading, a row being cancelled or dragged.

ambient-light.$description: Peak strength of the cover light behind a page header on the light theme. The contrast proof is apps/web/src/scripts/ambientPalette.test.ts.

ambient-dark.$description: The same on the dark theme, where a tint needs more to read.

haptic.$description: Touch patterns. Android plays the milliseconds through navigator.vibrate (the web cannot set strength, only length: under about 10 ms is not felt on the owner's phone and 20 ms or more is too strong, so the family stays at 12 to 20 ms, 2026-11-01); iPhone has no such call, so a tick is the hidden switch input of Safari 18 and a pattern is a count of ticks, gap_ms apart. Never read in CSS: buildTokens.ts writes them to apps/web/src/design-system/hapticTokens.ts.

tick-light.$description: The lightest tick, 12 ms: a press, a toggle, a detent, a skip.

tick.$description: One soft knock, 16 ms: a sheet or menu opening, play.

thud.$description: Two soft beats, a little closer: something did not work. The error sound is one low thud.

celebrate.$description: Two rising beats, one for each note of the ta-da: a podcast is ready to play.

surface.$description: Page background. Safari 26 samples this for the status bar tint. A cool off-white in light mode: pure white behind a full page of text glares; sheets and floating chrome stay white and read as raised.

surface-sunken.$description: Wells, inputs, hover fills, track backgrounds.

surface-container.$description: The tonal fill of a control that sits on the page: the search pill, a play chip, a secondary button, an unselected filter chip. Reads against the page without an outline.

on-surface-reading.$description: Running text read under a heading in on-surface: a story's summary, an episode highlight. One step under the heading's ink so the headline leads with no change of size or weight (no heading is bold, D125); 7:1 on the page and 4.5:1 on every surface.

on-surface-subtle.$description: Tertiary text. Still 4.5:1 on every surface; never lighter.

on-surface-disabled.$description: Disabled controls only. Exempt from contrast by WCAG 1.4.3.

border-hairline.$description: Decorative dividers. Below 3:1 by intent; never the only identifier of a control.

border-control.$description: Boundary of an input or segmented control. 3:1 against its surface (WCAG 1.4.11).

track-strong.$description: Unplayed item ticks and upcoming nodes.

accent.$description: Lingonberry. Interactive emphasis, progress, current state. Used as text at 4.5:1.

accent-subtle.$description: Tint behind the current row. Text on it stays on-surface or accent.

accent-container.$description: The selected state of a control: a chosen chip or segment, the current destination, a tonal button, the playing chip. Text on it is on-accent-container.

accent-container-high.$description: The tone of an action that is not a place: the New episode buttons. Stronger than accent-container, so it is not read as the current destination or a chosen chip beside it. Text on it is on-accent-container-high.

accent-action.$description: The tone of the one creating action in the side column (Catch up). Richer than accent-container, so it reads as an action and never as the current place. A saturated blue in both themes, as the greyed blues before it looked muddy in light and desaturated in dark (owner, 2026-10-27): in light blue-500 with white words, a step brighter than the full accent (blue-600); in dark blue-400 with the darkest blue's words. It reaches 3:1 against the page as a shape, with no outline or shadow. Text on it is on-accent-action.

on-accent-action.$description: Text and icons on accent-action, at 4.5:1 in rest, hover and press.

accent-action-state.$description: The ink accent-action's hover and press layers mix in. It moves the fill away from the words, so they gain contrast in every state: in light the words are white and the fill deepens toward the darkest blue; in dark the words are the darkest blue and the fill lightens toward blue-50, a white that keeps the blue's hue (pure white has none, and the oklch mix drifted toward violet).

cover-accent.$description: Defaults to the accent. The expanded player overrides it per digest from the cover palette (see design spec, color flow).

focus-gap.$description: Inner ring color. Components on raised surfaces override it locally.

image-outline.$description: 1px outline on covers for perceived edge, per DESIGN.md.

dialog.$description: Settings and Generate dialog width from 40rem.

window-controls.$description: Reserved top-leading corner for iPadOS windowed apps. env() does not report it.

measure.$description: Reading measure cap. In rem, not ch: 68ch resolved to about 702px in this face, wider than the 592px reading column, so it capped nothing and summary lines ran to 85 characters.

icon.$description: How an icon is drawn, for every icon at once.

bold.$description: 0 draws the regular weight, 1 the bold weight (Phosphor's own bold, not a stroke on the regular). Every Icon holds both; this picks one. A style that wants heavier line icons sets it to 1 (D268).

touch.$description: Minimum touch target. WCAG 2.5.5 and Apple HIG.

option.$description: A row in a list that opens as a bottom sheet on a phone: a select's, a picker's, a menu's. One height, so they read as one sheet.

icon-sm.$description: A glyph inside a line of text: a source link's arrow, an error's mark, a chevron after a label.

breakpoint.$description: Documentation values. CSS media queries cannot read custom properties, so foundations.css repeats these literals.

side.$description: The side navigation replaces the bottom navigation.

aside.$description: The story list column appears beside the briefing.

haptic.$description: What a control asks for. A call site names one of these and never a pattern or a number; buildTokens.ts writes them to apps/web/src/design-system/hapticTokens.ts.

navigate.$description: A move between pages: the lightest tick, so every press answers.

tap.$description: A plain press: the lightest tick, so every press answers.

select.$description: A switch or a choice changing.

detent.$description: A step of a scrubber or a wheel.

open.$description: A sheet or menu opening, and a card held.

close.$description: A sheet or menu closing: quiet, opening was the cue.

start.$description: A run beginning: Generate, Catch up, play.

ready.$description: A podcast is ready to play.

size-hero.$description: The cover in a page header on a phone, over the title. Never smaller than the wide header's, so the cover does not shrink when its Library card opens into its page.

size-hero-wide.$description: The cover in a page header from 40rem: as tall as the title, its facts and Play stacked beside it.

gutter.$description: Space reserved left of the briefing for the rail.

center.$description: Distance from the briefing's leading edge to the rail line center.

node-chapter.$description: Chapter node edge. A rounded square, so chapters and items read as different marks at a glance.

node-halo.$description: Halo spread around the current node.

gap.$description: Between two stories, split by the hairline: half above it, half below.

radius-pressed.$description: The corners of a filled call to action held down: the pill by default; a style may squeeze it into a softer rectangle.

radius.$description: A 16px rounded rectangle, the one recorded exception to the pill rule (D186): the side column's Catch up, so its shape alone tells it from the pill-shaped current row beside it (owner, 2026-10-27).
A full pill, as every Google button is. Rows and fields have their own radius (row.radius, field.radius).

inset.$description: Padding inside the bar and gap to the viewport edge.

radius.$description: Concentric: control radius (sm) plus inset padding.

bg.$description: Neutral. The player no longer takes a tint from the cover.

dismiss-distance.$description: Fraction of sheet height past which a slow release dismisses.

dismiss-velocity.$description: Release velocity in px per ms past which any downward flick dismisses.

track-active.$description: Rendered as scaleY(2) of the track while dragging.

chapter-gap.$description: The gap cut into the timeline where a story starts, as YouTube cuts chapters.

tick-dot.$description: A marker on the timeline where a story starts: one small dot, the same for every story.

detent-hysteresis.$description: Fraction of an item's length a scrub must move back before the same detent re-arms.

height.$description: As tall as a select or a field beside it.

radius.$description: Concentric: segment radius (sm) plus track padding.
A full pill, as every button, chip and select is (owner, 2026-10-24): one control, one shape.

radius-multiline.$description: A multi-line field cannot be a pill, so it takes half the field's height: its corners draw the same arc as a one-line field's.

max-height-multiline.$description: A multi-line field grows with its text up to this, then scrolls inside, so what sits under it (a count, a Reset) stays in reach (the Structure prompt, 2026-10-24).

label-gap.$description: A label onto the field it names: 12px, a step over 8 so the label does not sit on the outline, and under the gap between two fields (24px) so it still belongs to its own (owner, 2026-10-29).

chevron-gap.$description: Value text to chevron, on every dropdown.

radius.$description: A capsule: track and thumb are both fully round, so they stay concentric at any size.
A bottom sheet's top corners: 32px, the picker's, so every phone sheet shares one corner (owner, 2026-11-01).
Concentric: cover thumb radius (sm) plus row padding.

chip.$description: The tonal pill that plays a briefing or a story: a play mark and a short label on the container fill, no outline. It takes the accent container while it is the loaded story.

height.$description: Visible height. The hit area extends to the touch size.

padding-start.$description: Tighter on the glyph side, so the mark sits optically inside the pill.

glyph.$description: The slot the play, pause, check, bars and spinner share.

ring.$description: The stroke of one bar of the playing mark, and the gap between bars.

icon.$description: The play or pause mark in its slot.

radius-selected.$description: A ticked filter chip's corners. Equal to the chip's own radius by default; a style may make a selection change shape.

height.$description: Top bar, before the top safe area is added.

bar-height.$description: Bottom navigation on phones, before the bottom safe area is added.

indicator-width.$description: The pill behind the current destination's icon in the bottom bar.

indicator-radius-current.$description: The current destination's pill in the bottom bar and the side rail: fully round by default; a style may make it a rounded rectangle.

side-width.$description: Side navigation from 64rem: the wordmark over three destinations.

side-item-height.$description: One destination row in the side navigation.

side-item-bg.$description: Fill behind the current destination: the pill in the bottom bar and the row in the side column.

side-item-fg.$description: Label and icon of the current destination.

padding-block.$description: Space above and below an archive or settings row. Stories use item.gap.

radius.$description: A tappable row, a list option and the state layer over them.

tile-radius.$description: A link row's tile on the page (.row-action, the Sources list): fully round, as the rail's rows and a card's tiles are (owner, 2026-10-24: "full curved borders so it is consistent with the rest of the design language"). In a card the tile takes the card's inner radius instead.

slider.$description: A range input in a settings row.

max-width.$description: The widest a slider grows in a row, so the name beside it keeps the room (owner, 2026-10-25).

picker.$description: A searchable list (.picker-pop): a popover on a desktop, a sheet on a phone. What it holds, the search field and each option, sits one inset in from its edge and takes the inner radius, so every corner is concentric with the list: outer = inner + inset (owner, 2026-10-31). A control inside a picker reads these, never a radius of its own.

radius.$description: Concentric: the inner radius plus the inset (24 + 8 = 32). The list's own outer radius, a popover's and a phone sheet's alike.

inset.$description: From the list's edge to the search field and to the options: 8px on a popover and a phone sheet alike (owner, 2026-11-01).

inner-radius.$description: The search field and each option, one inset in. 24px: a full pill on the 48px search field, the same on every row.

scene.$description: The colours a style's own empty-state scenes are drawn with (D306). The Default scenes do not read them: they draw with the accent container and its deeper tone (empty.css). Each role is a place in a scene, not a hue: a style gives its own values, so a pumpkin may be orange in Halloween and anything in another style.

halo.$description: How strongly a scene's light glows round it, 0 to 1. Zero draws none.

card.$description: A group of settings rows in one rounded container on the container tone (.card-group). What it holds is concentric with it: a surface one inset in takes the inner radius, content one padding in takes the content radius (2026-10-22).

padding.$description: From the card's edge to its rows' words, and to its chips. The page's title, heads and notes start the same distance in, so a page with cards has one left text edge (2026-10-22).

inset.$description: From the card's edge to a surface inside it, on every side: a row's hover tile, a select's fill. Two tiles sit the same distance apart. 4px, so a tile and its target are nearly the card's width (owner, 2026-10-24: "4px padding is decent").

radius.$description: Concentric: a surface's inner radius plus its inset.

inner-radius.$description: A row's hover tile, one inset in from the card's edge: the card's radius less the inset.

content-radius.$description: Content one padding in from the card's edge (a chip, a button, a field, a picture): the card's radius less its padding.

chip-hover.$description: The hover layer of a chip on a card: half the state layer in light, where the chip is white and the full 8% would take it past the card's own tone (L 94 on L 95) so it melted in; the full layer in dark, where hover lifts the chip away from the card (owner, 2026-10-24).

styles.$description: Styles replace existing semantic and component tokens under data-style (D268). One group per style, mirroring the token tree. Default is the tokens above.

expressive.$description: Material 3 Expressive: a heavier, tighter page title, larger corners, covers and cards that read as shapes (owner, 2026-10-31). Only the display role is bold; headings stay regular (D268).

halloween.$description: A seasonal style (D306): violet-black and parchment neutrals, the existing orange ramp as the accent, a blackletter page title, and its own empty-state scenes and corner cobweb (halloween art in components/halloweenArt.ts, cobweb.ts). Only the display role takes the blackletter face.
